about_the_game:
About MID

MID brings players from around the world together in the same round, offering an immersive competitive environment with diverse visuals. In this game, you can win either by contributing to MID or by simply accumulating steaks. At the end of each round, 10% of the total steak contribution is distributed proportionally among all steak owners based on the amount of steaks they own.

How to play

  • Determine your steak contribution amount based on your strategy (minimum 1).

  • Contribute to MID with the right strategy before the time runs out.

  • In that round, the MID is the middle option chosen by all contributors, and it becomes the winner.

Made Features

  • The number of steaks is limited to 100 million units.

  • The number of bones is limited to 1 million units.

  • You can earn steaks by contributing to MID.

  • You can earn more steaks by accumulating steaks.

  • You can craft steaks.

  • You can craft bones.

  • Each round lasts 1 minute.

Note

  • Every user receives free steak.

  • In the game, users can optionally purchase the bone item to craft steak.

short_description: It is a massive multiplayer strategy clicking game where every player gathers in shared excitement. To win, you must contribute to the MID before its time runs out, or collect the fixed number of Steaks to claim your share of the total contribution. Every click is very important!
